focus: Smart Contract Security (DeFi Risk Management Platform)

impacts: Direct theft of any user funds, whether at-rest or in-motion, other than unclaimed yield
Temporary freezing of funds (greater than 1 month)
Loss of staker funds by profitable theft
Profitable dilution of staker funds (infinite minting of staking positions)

reasons.Mainnet/Testnet Testing: All testing should be done on local forks of testnet or mainnet
reasons.Pricing Oracles: Incorrect data supplied by third party oracles (oracle manipulation/flash loan attacks are in-scope)
reasons.Third-party Systems: Any testing with third-party systems and applications is prohibited
reasons.DoS Attacks: Any denial of service attacks that are executed against project assets are strictly forbidden
reasons.Known Issues: Known issues in previous audits are considered out-of-scope (https://github.com/sherlock-protocol/sherlock-v2-core/tree/main/audits)
reasons.Centralization Risks: Impacts involving centralization risks are out-of-scope
reasons.Governance Attacks: Impacts requiring basic economic and governance attacks (e.g. 51% attack) are out-of-scope
reasons.Privileged Access: Impacts caused by attacks requiring access to privileged addresses (governance, strategist contracts) without additional modifications are out-of-scope
reasons.Social Engineering: Impacts requiring phishing or other social engineering attacks are out-of-scope

specific_exclusions: Incorrect data supplied by third party oracles (not to exclude oracle manipulation/flash loan attacks)
Impacts requiring basic economic and governance attacks (e.g. 51% attack)
Impacts requiring attacks that the reporter has already exploited themselves, leading to damage
Impacts caused by attacks requiring access to leaked keys/credentials
Impacts caused by attacks requiring access to privileged addresses without additional modifications
Impacts relying on attacks involving the depegging of an external stablecoin where the attacker does not directly cause the depegging
Mentions of secrets, access tokens, API keys, private keys in Github without proof of production use
Impacts on test files and configuration files unless stated otherwise

oracle_manipulation.reason: Oracle manipulation and flash loan attacks are explicitly in-scope, even though incorrect data from third-party oracles is out-of-scope

profitable_exploits_only.reason: To be eligible for reward, all thefts must be profitable and all freezing must be reasonably priced for the impact

unprofitable_freezing.reason: Material loss/freezing of user funds that is unprofitable for the hacker is classified as High (not Critical)

high_effort_dos.reason: Automated testing of services that generates significant amounts of traffic is not permitted

previous_audit_issues.reason: Issues identified in previous audit reports may not be eligible for payout

Critical.criteria: Exploits that result in a material loss of funds for users and is profitable for the hacker
examples: Direct theft of any user funds
Loss of staker funds by profitable theft

High.criteria: Material loss/freezing of user funds that is unprofitable for the hacker
examples: Temporary freezing of funds (greater than 1 month)

requirements.testing_environment: Local forks of testnet or mainnet only
requirements.disclosure_policy: Do not publicly disclose vulnerabilities before they are resolved

prohibited_activities: Any testing on mainnet or public testnet deployed code
Any testing with pricing oracles or third-party smart contracts
Attempting phishing or other social engineering attacks
Any testing with third-party systems and applications
Any denial of service attacks that are executed against project assets
Automated testing of services that generates significant amounts of traffic
Public disclosure of an unpatched vulnerability in an embargoed bounty
Never exploit a vulnerability or threaten to do so
Do not attempt to rescue funds without the written consent of the protocol customer

ethical_standards: Adhere to ethical standards and legal guidelines
No harm: Ensure that your testing does not negatively impact users or infrastructure
Always default to the assumption that the protocol team has good intentions
Do not threaten, blackmail, dox, or otherwise create a negative environment
Do not communicate with the protocol customer outside of the official channel provided by Sherlock
platform_rules.dispute_resolution: By submitting a vulnerability through Sherlock, you are agreeing to abide by the outcome of the Sherlock dispute resolution process

notes: Sherlock is a DeFi risk management platform providing smart contract coverage
Bug bounty program is focused on smart contracts only
Rewards are distributed according to the Immunefi Vulnerability Severity Classification System V2.2
PoC is required for Critical and High Smart Contract bug reports
Payouts are handled by the Sherlock team directly in USDC
Total assets in scope: 15 smart contracts
